summary: This note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on Madina Lake, an American alternative rock band. It covers the band's formation in Chicago in 2005, its debut album released through Roadrunner Records in 2007, a Kerrang! Awards honor, and its disbanding and later reunion.
one_line: Madina Lake is an American alternative rock band formed in Chicago in 2005, known for its 2007 debut album.
key_facts: Madina Lake is an American alternative rock band.
Madina Lake was formed in Chicago in 2005.
Madina Lake released their debut album "From Them, Through Us, to You".
The debut album "From Them, Through Us, to You" was released through Roadrunner Records.
The debut album "From Them, Through Us, to You" was released on March 27, 2007.
Madina Lake won Best International Newcomer at the Kerrang! Awards 2007.
Madina Lake reunited in February 2017 after disbanding.
